items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Joe Stevens, huh? I don't know. You see the band? Yeah, just Joe Stevens, the drummer. [INTERVIEWEE] The last time I heard Johnny had a white band.

ctx.x: Did you play...you used to play down the weekends or what? No, he just used to get up there.

Every once in a while. He moved further down. Oh, yeah? That's the one where...how do you call it? Son was playing drums, huh? Was that Luke Skiro? That Johnny's...right baby Steven's son was there? Joe Stevens, huh? I don't know. You see the band? Yeah, just Joe Stevens, the drummer.
The last time I heard Johnny had a white band.
